TS030 if-braces

A branch that spans more than one line carries braces, so a later statement cannot join the body by accident.

languages: javascript odin typescript zig
severity: warning
default: on
group: stable
go: Go requires braces on every if, so an unbraced one does not parse
python: Python blocks are indentation, not braces
rust: Rust requires braces on every if, so an unbraced one does not parse

TigerStyle: "Add braces to the `if` statement unless it fits on a single line for consistency and defense in depth against \"goto fail;\" bugs."
